default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-568.title: Seasonal-path deviation fade
E-568.hypothesis: Price tends to follow an average intraday path (same minute, last sessions); when the day's move strays from that path by more than its usual size, the stray is liquidity-driven and reverts toward the path.

E-569.title: Day-open cross follow
E-569.hypothesis: After staying on one side of the session open for a while, a close across it shows the morning's positioning has been overturned; trapped traders add fuel to the move.

E-570.title: Autocorrelation regime bar trade
E-570.hypothesis: When recent one-bar returns are negatively autocorrelated the tape is mean-reverting (fade the large bar); when positively, it is trending (follow it).

E-571.title: US-cash-open anchor follow
E-571.hypothesis: From the US cash open, order flow from S&P-linked investors moves WIN; a move from the anchor that is larger than usual for the clock time is information-driven and keeps going.

E-572.title: Clean-side micro-trend break follow
E-572.hypothesis: If the price has stayed almost entirely on one side of VWAP (few side flips), institutions are working an order on that side; a break of the last few minutes' extreme in that direction continues.

E-573.title: Prior-day midpoint cross follow
E-573.hypothesis: The previous session's range midpoint is a fair-value reference; a close across it after a spell on the other side shifts acceptance and follows through.

E-574.title: Same-minute drift persistence
E-574.hypothesis: Recurring flows (rebalancing, hedging, US data windows) push price the same way at the same clock time; trade the sign of the average forward 30-minute return when it is statistically distinct.

E-575.title: Body-through-VWAP bar follow
E-575.hypothesis: A single large-bodied bar that opens on one side of VWAP and closes on the other is an aggressive repricing through the benchmark algos trade against; follow it.

E-576.title: Heavy-open-volume range break follow
E-576.hypothesis: A heavy first window of volume relative to recent sessions signals large participants with a view; a break of that window's range afterward follows the aggressor.

E-577.title: Bar-colour imbalance without progress fade
E-577.hypothesis: Many bars of one colour but little net displacement means the aggressive side is being absorbed by passive limit orders; fade the colour majority.
